purpose: P5-only bounded perception expansion. Test whether 788 candidate substructures can be separately localized. 788 is revisable search memory, not ground truth.

memory_788.warning: Names and relations guide inspection only; they do not establish existence, boundaries, semantic category, or LocalObservation status. AMBIGUOUS or NOT_OBSERVABLE may revise 788.

candidate_searches.question: Can authorized pixels localize a structural region corresponding to the diagonal/stair sector signaled by 788?
Can authorized pixels separately localize a structural region corresponding to the platform/terrace sector signaled by 788?
If A and B are sufficiently localizable, can authorized pixels localize a visible junction/termination region between them?
candidate_searches.dependency: REQUIRES_A_AND_B_SUFFICIENTLY_LOCALIZABLE; otherwise NOT_OBSERVABLE is permitted and no junction may be invented.

outcome_semantics.LOCALIZABLE: Requires normalized candidate_roi directly justified by pixels.
outcome_semantics.AMBIGUOUS: Structure perceptible but multiple reasonable delimitations remain; candidate_roi must be null.
outcome_semantics.NOT_OBSERVABLE: Pixels do not permit honest isolation; candidate_roi must be null.

response_invariants: Exactly three requested candidate_id values, once each.
Every provenance: photo_index=5, exact search_roi=[0.13,0.04,0.88,0.79], matching candidate_id, non-empty pixel_cues.
LOCALIZABLE requires candidate_roi inside search_roi and localization_basis DIRECTLY_LOCALIZED or PARTIALLY_BOUNDED.
Semantic interpretation is separate from localization; diagonal is not automatically stair, horizontal is not automatically platform/terrace.
Candidate C is conditional; if A or B is insufficiently localizable, C may be NOT_OBSERVABLE and no junction may be invented.
788 is revisable memory, not a target to confirm; response may contradict it.
Relations optional; only directly visible allowed tokens.
No physical identity, SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT, LIKELY_SAME, metric geometry, camera pose, hidden continuation, external knowledge.
No LocalObservation creation and no automatic ingestion.
